To find the spring constant of a helical spring by plotting the graph between load and extension.
Aim:To find the spring constant of a helical spring by plotting a graph between load and extension.
To do the experiment, we need the following: rigid stand, metre scale, helical spring, 50 gm weight hanger and 50 gm slotted weights.
Take the helical spring and fix it on the rigid stand. Hang a 50 gm weight hanger at the end of the spring. Now, the spring extends and the pointer moves downward. Note the reading on the scale.
Record the scale reading on a tabular column.
Take a 50 gm weight and put it on the weight hanger. The pointer moves downward. Note the reading on the scale.
Record the mass, load and the pointer reading in the tabular column.
Place another 50 gm weight on the weight hanger. The pointer moves downward. Note the reading on the scale.
Record the mass, load and the pointer reading in the tabular column.
Place another 50 gm weight on the weight hanger. The pointer moves downward. Note the reading on the scale. Repeat the experiment with another two 50 gram weights.
Record the mass, load and the pointer reading in the tabular column.
Now, remove a 50 gm weight from the weight hanger. The pointer moves upward. Note the reading on the scale.
Record the scale reading in the tabular column.
Remove another 50 gm weight from the weight hanger. The pointer moves upward. Note the reading on the scale.
Record the scale reading in the tabular column.
Remove another 50 gm weight from the weight hanger. The pointer moves upward. Note the reading on the scale. Repeat the experiment by removing the remaining two 50 gm weights.
Record the scale reading in the tabular column. Calculate the value of spring constant in each case. The mean value of spring constant is then calculated.
The spring constant of the given spring= 35 N/m
Plot a graph with Load along the X axis and Extension along the Y axis. The spring constant can be found from the slope of the graph.
By calculation and from the graph, the spring constant of the helical spring is obtained as 35 N/m.
